extracted.intended_audience: researchers (especially would-be or early-career reviewers) wanting to start peer reviewing
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers on how to become a journal peer reviewer and what journal editors expect from review reports and reviewer conduct. Covers the purpose and types of peer review, reviewer duties, what editors look for, and practical tips to increase chances of being invited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: You will hear about the purpose of peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The webinar begins by providing would-be reviewers with a thorough grounding in the topic, including explanation of why peer review exists and its role in scholarly publishing (presented as foundational context for reviewers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Varying types of peer review, including single and double blind.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The session explains different peer review models (explicitly mentions single and double blind) so reviewers understand the confidentiality and identity conventions that may apply to assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duties of a reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: Explores the duties of a reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The webinar outlines reviewer responsibilities (general expectations for conduct and scope of review) as part of preparing new reviewers to perform the role appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors look for reviews that are thorough and detailed; the page highlights 'comprehensive reports' as one of the specific things editors want to receive from reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear recommendations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alongside comprehensive commentary, editors want explicit, unambiguous recommendations (e.g., accept/revise/reject or other actionable guidance) from reviewers to inform editorial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: How editors find reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: How editors find reviewers and what you can do to increase your chances of receiving an invite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The webinar explains editors' reviewer-selection processes and provides practical tips researchers can apply to increase visibility and likelihood of being invited to review (tips aimed at taking the first steps toward becoming a reviewer).

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical tips for becoming a reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical tips that will help you take the first step on the path to becoming a reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The recording promises actionable advice for would-be reviewers — likely covering visibility, networking, profile maintenance, and behaviours that make editors more likely to invite you (presented as concrete steps though the page text does not enumerate them).
